flagged 'no text layer'
reported by list_documents
so the agent does not search there
OCR is explicitly out of scope

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A note on threading.
The architecture originally called for a worker we wrote.
pdf.js already parses in its own worker; wrapping that in a
second one means nesting workers for no measured gain and
one more failure mode. What remains on the main thread is
text assembly and chunking — milliseconds per page — and we
yield between pages. 89 pages ingest with no visible jank.
The honest answer beats a worker we did not need.

svg.text: Ingestion — plaintext never leaves the tab
